chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibn Bukayr, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Washing the head with the hibiscus (khitmah) every Friday is a safety from vitiligo and insanity.

key_terms.الْبَرَصِ: Vitiligo, a skin condition characterized by loss of color in patches.
key_terms.الْخِطْمِيِّ: A type of plant, often identified as hibiscus or a specific shrub, used for ritual washing.

ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of washing the head with khitmah on Friday according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) prescribes washing the head with *khitmah* (a type of mint or basil) on Fridays as a means of safeguarding against vitiligo (*baras*) and insanity (*junun*). This practice reflects the Shia tradition of linking specific physical remedies with spiritual timing, emphasizing the holistic well-being of the believer through prophetic medicine (*tibb al-nabawi*).
